```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
  geom_jitter(color = "blue", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +  
  geom_smooth(color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +  
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = TEAM), size = 2, color = "purple", box.padding = 0.2) +
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Your data and preprocessing
# Assuming mlb_total_cap, nhl_total_cap, nfl_total_cap, nba_total_cap, and championship_teams are defined

names(mlb_total_cap)[names(mlb_total_cap) == "TotalPayroll"] <- "TotalCap"

mlb_total_cap$league <- "MLB"
nhl_total_cap$league <- "NHL"
nfl_total_cap$league <- "NFL"
nba_total_cap$league <- "NBA"

# Example data preparation
mlb_total_cap <- mlb_total_cap[, c("Year", "Team", "TotalCap", "league")]
nhl_total_cap <- nhl_total_cap[, c("Year", "Team", "TotalCap", "league")]
nfl_total_cap <- nfl_total_cap[, c("Year", "Team", "TotalCap", "league")]
nba_total_cap <- nba_total_cap[, c("Year", "Team", "TotalCap", "league")]

mlb_cols <- c("Year", "Team", "TotalCap", "league")
nhl_cols <- c("Year", "Team", "TotalCap", "league")
nfl_cols <- c("Year", "Team", "TotalCap", "league") 
nba_cols <- c("Year", "Team", "TotalCap", "league")  

mlb_total_cap <- mlb_total_cap[mlb_cols]
nhl_total_cap <- nhl_total_cap[nhl_cols]
nfl_total_cap <- nfl_total_cap[nfl_cols]
nba_total_cap <- nba_total_cap[nba_cols]

combined_data <- rbind(mlb_total_cap, nhl_total_cap, nfl_total_cap, nba_total_cap)

# Filter data for teams that have won a championship in the last decade
championship_teams <- c("Golden State Warriors", "Los Angeles Dodgers", "New England Patriots", "Tampa Bay Lightning")  

filtered_data <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Team %in% championship_teams)

# Plotting
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = Year, y = TotalCap, color = league)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Average team spending vs the best teams",
       caption = "Data as of 2023, courtesy of StatMuse",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Average Salary Cap") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(combined_data$Year), max(combined_data$Year), by = 2)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(  
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_line(data = filtered_data, aes(x = Year, y = TotalCap, color = league), size = 1, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = filtered_data %>% group_by(Team) %>% filter(Year == max(Year)),
            aes(label = Team, x = Year, y = TotalCap),
            hjust = -0.2,
            vjust = 0.5,
            size = 2) + 
  expand_limits(x = c(min(combined_data$Year), max(combined_data$Year) + 3)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NHL" = "blue", "NBA" = "red", "MLB" = "darkgreen", "NFL" = "purple"),
                     labels = c("NHL Average", "NBA Average", "MLB Average", "NFL Average")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Legend"))  # You can rename the legend title if you wish
```

```{r}
championship_teams <- c("Buffalo Sabres", "New York Jets", "Miami Marlins", "Detroit Pistons")  

filtered_data <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Team %in% championship_teams)

  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Average team spending vs the worst teams",
       caption = "Data as of 2023, courtesy of StatMuse",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Average Salary Cap",
       color = "Legend") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(combined_data$Year), max(combined_data$Year), by = 2)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(  
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_line(data = filtered_data, aes(x = Year, y = TotalCap, color = league), size = 1, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = filtered_data %>% group_by(Team) %>% filter(Year == max(Year)),
            aes(label = Team, x = Year, y = TotalCap),
            hjust = -0.2,
            vjust = 0.5,
            size = 2) + 
  expand_limits(x = c(min(combined_data$Year), max(combined_data$Year) + 3)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NHL" = "blue", "NBA" = "red", "MLB" = "darkgreen", "NFL" = "purple"),
                     labels = c("NHL Average", "NBA Average", "MLB Average", "NFL Average")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Legend"))
```
